title: XE IPO lockup ended early — X-Energy, 2026-09-01 (prospectus clause: 10 trading days before the Q3 blackout)
source: SEC: 8-K Item 7.01 filed 2026-06-04 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2088896/000119312526256369/xe-20260604.htm — the company states the 180-day Restricted Period (scheduled 2026-10-20) falls inside its quarterly blackout, so under the 424B4 clause it ends 2026-09-01, ten trading days before the blackout; restated in the 10-Q filed 2026-08-13 ("restrictions on their ability to sell or transfer their equity until September 1, 2026"). Corrects scripts/research/lockup-discovery.mjs, which dated it 2026-10-20 from the 424B4's 180-day wording and missed the blackout clause. Id keeps the discovered date (an id is a file name).
notes: $1.0B offering. The unlock already happened on 2026-09-01: XE is -53% from its $23.00 IPO price and -42% since that date, so the 'insiders may sell from the next session' framing no longer applies. Researched as a completed event; see the ledger Outcome.
